title: Book Two · Chapter 160: The Line Leo Finds
story:
For the fourth practice, Ronan gets a page with a room plan and two short notices. The task is to tell a visitor where to collect a reading packet.

He finds the room on the plan. He finds the collection time. He thinks the wet-day notice sends visitors to a different desk.

The picture has three desks. Ronan looks from one to another. He mixes up the words from the two notices.

Miss Wu tells the students they can finish alone or ask a group member for help. She will write down who gets help. She does this for every practice.

Ronan reads the wet-day notice again. He cannot connect it to the plan. He looks at the clock, then at Leo.

“Can you help me find the desk?”

Leo moves his chair closer. “Which part is the problem?”

“I thought it was a room at the back. But there are two rooms there.”

Leo reads both notices. He points to a line near the bottom of the first page.

“The packets are at the desk beside the stairs. The wet-day notice changes the entrance. It does not change the desk.”

Ronan follows Leo's finger. He sees it now. He puts his own pencil beside the stairs on the plan.

“So I go through the covered entrance, then turn right.”

“Yes. Read the last line too.”

Ronan reads it and finds the collection number. Then he can explain the whole route.

Miss Wu listens. Ronan tells her that Leo found the important line. She marks HELP at the bottom of his paper and writes a short note beside it.

“Keep this page,” she says. “Try a different plan alone at home. You had help with this task.”

Ronan nods. He folds the bottom strip under because the page is longer than his folder. The answer and his name stay on the front. The HELP box is inside the fold.

Leo packs his own paper.

“Thank you,” Ronan says.

“You found the time yourself.”

“But not the desk.”

“No.”

They leave the room together. Rain is starting, so they stand beneath the roof by the steps. Ronan thinks of the covered entrance on the plan and laughs a little.

“Our page has better weather than we do,” he says.

“It has an answer for rain.”

“Ours is to wait.”

They watch water gather at the edge of the yard. After a few minutes, Mei joins them. She has a cloth over her folder and offers a dry corner for Ronan's paper.

He puts it there until the rain slows. Then they hold their bags close and walk to the gate. The note about Leo's help is inside the fold. Ronan can still read it when he opens the page.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

collect＝领取；entrance＝入口；covered＝有遮盖的；fold＝折痕、折起。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan以为雨天要换什么？Leo找到的那一行说明了哪项改变、哪项不变？
2. 第四次练习的原纸怎样记录了帮助，后来怎样被折起？

## 读句子

**The wet-day notice changes the entrance.**

拆开看：The wet-day notice / changes / the entrance.

雨天通知／改变了／入口安排。
